title: Michigan Dispensary Deals & Cannabis Specials
metaDescription: See the cannabis deals at High Society’s eight Michigan dispensaries. Deals vary by store: pick yours to shop its menu and order ahead for pickup.
h1: Cannabis Deals at High Society Dispensaries

hero.lead: Deals at High Society change often and differ from store to store. Each store’s menu lists its deals next to the prices, so pick your store to see what is on today.

blocks.heading: Featured Deals
blocks.lead: Our featured offers. Terms and availability vary by store, so check your store’s menu before you visit.

blocks.heading: Deals at Your Store
blocks.lead: Every store runs its own deals. Open your store’s menu to see them with today’s prices.

blocks.heading: Join The Society
blocks.md: Sign up to get early access to strain drops, special pricing, birthday rewards and more. Members earn 500 points for every $100 spent, with four tiers from Member to Diamond.

blocks.heading: Order Ahead for Pickup
blocks.md: Browse your store’s menu online, add items to your cart and choose a pickup time. Prefer curbside? Tell us at checkout and we will text you when your order is ready.

blocks.heading: The small print
blocks.md: Deals vary by store, change often and are shown with prices on each store’s menu. Recreational customers must be 21 or older with a valid government-issued ID; medical patients need a valid medical marijuana card. Please consume responsibly.

blocks.heading: Download the High Society App
blocks.md: Experience convenience at your fingertips with the High Society App. Easily browse our full cannabis menu, stay updated on the latest deals, and place your orders with just a few taps. Whether you're at home or on the go, managing your cannabis experience has never been easier.
